environment.description: Provider binary executed inside a hardened OCI container on a Kubernetes node with a pod-level annotation specifying a custom seccomp profile loaded via the kubelet's --seccomp-profile-root. The profile (referenced as 'localhost/terraform-provider-restricted.json') uses a whitelist approach with defaultAction SCMP_ACT_ERRNO. The allowed syscall set includes read, write, close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, rt_sigreturn, ioctl, access, pipe, select, sched_yield, mremap, madvise, nanosleep, getpid, clone (for goroutines only, with CLONE_VM|CLONE_FS|CLONE_FILES flags required), openat, newfstatat, futex, epoll_create1, epoll_ctl, epoll_pwait, getrandom, and exit_group. Notably absent from the whitelist: execve, execveat, socket, connect, bind, listen, accept, sendto, recvfrom, ptrace, and process_vm_readv. The container also runs with 'readOnlyRootFilesystem: true' and drops ALL capabilities. The Kubernetes node uses containerd 1.7.x with the seccomp profile enforcement verified via audit logging (auditd rule on seccomp events).

config.network_policy: deny-all egress except DNS on port 53 to kube-dns
